prompts.proposer:

The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_rf', seasonality_champion='rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: Trend champion CWT_rf achieves perfect correlation (1.0) with y_true trend, while rf leads seasonality capture (0.5602). Catboost wins overall RMSE (125.05) with exceptional early-horizon performance (49.54), but rf excels at late horizons (171.28). High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 47.25) and split trend/seasonality champions justify STL-hierarchical stacking with mixed weighting to exploit decomposition-aware combination.
